name: Johan
description: Wizard Xira served who sought Shauku's dominion.

description_citations.text: "Xira Arien". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Battle of Efrava is fought in the air over the oasis between airships, ending Johan's War.
timeline.quote: The war's last battle was the Battle of Efrava, which was fought in the air over the oasis between both sides' flying airships.

citation.text: "Efrava", section "Efrava in the time of Jedit Ojanen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Shauku lures Emperor Johan to her lair with promises of knowledge, then gives him a tome that drains his knowledge.
timeline.quote: it instead drained his pre-existing knowledge into its pages.

citation.text: "Shauku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Shauku detects Johan and locks him in an Amber Prison.
timeline.quote: locked him into an Amber Prison .

citation.text: "Shauku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Adira Strongheart's mercenaries free Johan; Jedit Ojanen knocks Shauku back and the freed Cosmic Horror summons a Falling Star that obliterates the ruin.
timeline.quote: the freed Cosmic Horror summoned a Falling Star to obliterate the entire ruin.

citation.text: "Shauku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan, tyrant of Tirras, tries to conquer western Jamuraa and clashes with the city-states led by Hazezon Tamar.
timeline.quote: was a powerful but evil mage who tried to conquer the Jamuraan western continent

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan's attempt to enslave the cat warrior tribes of the Sukurvian Desert leads them to ally with humans and defeat him.
timeline.quote: which would lead them to ally with the humans to ultimately defeat Johan

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan becomes Tyrant of Tirras and proclaims himself Emperor of the Northern Realm, warring with city-states south of Tirras.
timeline.quote: His first step was becoming Tyrant of Tirras , and proclaiming himself "Emperor of the Northern Realm".

citation.text: "Johan", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan's army is stalled at Palmyra by Hazezon and Jaeger and disperses in a magical sandstorm; Jaeger is killed by a sand wurm.
timeline.quote: his army ended up dispersing due to a magical sandstorm conjured by Hazezon .

citation.text: "Johan", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Disguised as a human, Johan reaches Efrava and uses a charm to manipulate Jedit into pleading to be his guardian.
timeline.quote: he used his mental control of Jedit to have him plead to be his guardian.

citation.text: "Johan", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan's treachery is discovered; he kills Efravan guards and flees west with Jedit in pursuit.
timeline.quote: Johan killed a couple of Efravan guards to escape to the desert

citation.text: "Johan", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Shauku lures Johan to her fortress to enslave him but he escapes and decides to enslave the cat warrior tribes.
timeline.quote: it turned out to be a plot to enslave him in her service.

citation.text: "Johan", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan captures the Robaran Mercenaries, but Hazezon shifts away and the city-states build a skyship fleet.
timeline.quote: Unbeknownst to him, Hazezon had learned to shift (to teleport) and was, therefore, able to escape.

citation.text: "Johan", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the final battle at Efrava, Johan turns Hazezon's spell against him and tears out Adira's heart.
timeline.quote: he killed Adira Strongheart by ripping her heart out of her chest with his bare hands.

citation.text: "Johan", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jedit charges Johan and they fall overboard; Johan is eaten by a sand wurm, as Jaeger had been.
timeline.quote: Johan died the same way Jaeger Ojanen had: eaten by a sand wurm .

citation.text: "Johan", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Johan dead, his generals turn on each other and the fleet flees; stranded troops surrender and Hazezon escorts them to Tirras.
timeline.quote: Hazezon Tamar would take pity on them and escort them back to their homeland of Tirras .

citation.text: "Johan", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tirras attacks Bryce; Jaeger saves Hazezon and leads the militia in repelling the invaders despite stone-throwing devils.
timeline.quote: led by him, the militia of Bryce repels the invaders, albeit at great cost.

citation.text: "Johan (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nightstalkers sent by Johan ambush Hazezon and Adira, changing Adira's mind to help Bryce.
timeline.quote: The ambush fails, but this changes Adira's mind and she decides that Palmyra will help Bryce.

citation.text: "Johan (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan boils the merfolk and destroys Palmyra's dam with an earthquake.
timeline.quote: Johan summons an earthquake that destroys the dam, freeing the river road down to Bryce.

citation.text: "Johan (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Beckoner reverses the River Toloron and dries it, forcing Johan's army to return north.
timeline.quote: Without means to transport supplies, Johan's army cannot reach Bryce by land and is forced to return north.

citation.text: "Johan (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hazezon summons sand warriors and a huge sandstorm as Tirrans besiege Palmyra.
timeline.quote: the real magic summoned by Hazezon is a huge sandstorm

citation.text: "Johan (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The sandstorm destroys Johan's army; Jaeger reveals he is the None and fights Johan, who is devoured by a sandworm.
timeline.quote: While the two are fighting, a sandworm leaps out and devours Jaeger.

citation.text: "Johan (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaeger's last words reveal other tiger men in the east, and Johan plans to make them part of his army.
timeline.quote: intends to make them part of his new army.

citation.text: "Johan (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan's forces attack Bryce; Hazezon, aided by Jaeger Ojanen and his sand warriors, leads the defense and halts the attack.
timeline.quote: The war began when Johan’s forces attacked Bryce

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hazezon alters the flow of the River Toloron to force Johan's army back, but Johan then besieges Palmyra and Hazezon summons a devastating sandstorm.
timeline.quote: Hazezon summoned a great sandstorm that devastated Johan’s forces

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaeger confronts Johan and is killed by a sandworm.
timeline.quote: Jaeger confronted Johan but was killed by a sandworm.

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jedit saves Johan from a sand wurm; under Efravan law Johan is imprisoned for execution, but Jedit and Hestia delay it and Johan later escapes.
timeline.quote: Johan escaped, and Jedit followed him

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Palmyra Johan deceives Jedit and unleashes his bloodlust against Hazezon and Adira; the Robarans reveal Jaeger was their friend and Jedit nearly kills Johan, who escapes with Beasts of Bogardan.
timeline.quote: Johan summoned Beasts of Bogardan to escape.

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan receives a vision from Shauku in the Western Wastes and is invited to her library in Arboria.
timeline.quote: Johan received a vision from Shauku

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan is tricked into an enchantment and imprisoned at Shauku's castle, where she reveals she is a vampire who manipulated him; Adira accidentally frees him and the castle is destroyed by a Falling Star.
timeline.quote: After Adira accidentally freed Johan, the group escaped

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan builds a fleet of airships powered by powerstones to invade Bryce, Efrava and the surrounding regions, while the resistance gathers allies and secures airships of its own.
timeline.quote: Johan sought to expand his dominion by constructing a fleet of airships powered by powerstones.

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan's forces besiege Efrava, and Jedit's coalition wages guerrilla warfare until reinforcements from Bryce and Scarwood arrive.
timeline.quote: The war reached its climax in Efrava

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the final confrontation Johan slays Adira but is dragged from the sky by Jedit and devoured by a colossal sand wurm, ending the war.
timeline.quote: Johan slew Adira but was ultimately dragged from the sky by Jedit.

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan, saved by Jedit from a sand wurm, is imprisoned in Efrava; Hestia delays his execution, he escapes and Jedit follows him.
timeline.quote: he manages to free himself and flees the oasis, followed by Jedit

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Palmyra Johan lies that Hazezon and Adira killed Jaeger and sends Jedit, under spells, to attack them; the spells conflict and the Robarans reveal the truth.
timeline.quote: permitting the Robaran Mercenaries to reveal to him that Jaeger was their good friend

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jedit sees Jaeger's medallion on Johan and realizes Johan killed his father; Johan escapes by summoning Beasts of Bogardan and receives a vision from Shauku.
timeline.quote: understands that the tyrant killed his father

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan learns Shauku's castle location from a sage in Buzzard's Bay and has the sage killed.
timeline.quote: from a local sage (promptly killed)

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Robarans are cleared of the sage's murder, attacked by Johan's corsairs and shipwrecked, then saved by Beckoner and the Born of the Beck.
timeline.quote: They are saved by Beckoner and the Born of the Beck tribe

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Shauku enchants Johan, reveals herself as a vampire and traps him in amber near the Cosmic Horror.
timeline.quote: Johan is then trapped in an amber prison near the horror.

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Robarans infiltrate Shauku's castle; Adira frees Johan, Jedit incapacitates Shauku, and they escape as the Falling Star destroys the castle.
timeline.quote: After Jedit incapacitates Shauku

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xira joins Johan's entourage seeking Shauku's dominion and is made to wait outside, which saves her life when a Falling Star annihilates the castle.
timeline.quote: This would inadvertently save Xira Arien's life

citation.text: "Xira Arien", section "The Glass Mountain". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jedit, Hazezon, Adira and the Seveners infiltrate Tirras to assassinate Johan but are captured; Hazezon and Adira are imprisoned, the rest sent to a work camp where Jedit learns of airships.
timeline.quote: they are quickly discovered and captured

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Robarans steal an airship, rouse the slaves, rescue Hazezon and Adira, but Johan's storm throws them off course.
timeline.quote: The Robarans manage to steal a ship, rouse the slaves, and sail through the air toward Tirras.

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan attacks Efrava; Jedit, now general of the Efravans, leads guerrilla warfare and allied reinforcements retake the village, and Adira devises a plan to attack Johan's ship.
timeline.quote: the alliance manages to recapture the village of the Efravans

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Robarans reach Johan's flagship; Adira stabs Johan but is killed by him; Jedit and Johan fall to the desert where a sand wurm eats Johan.
timeline.quote: a sand wurm emerges from the dunes and eats him

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: led by Hazezon Tamar and the Robaran Mercenaries

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: casts a command enchantment on Johan, binding the wizard to her will

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: His only rival, who bested him twice.
relations.quote: his only rival might have been Hazezon Tamar , who bested him twice.

relations.quote: The vampire lured him with the promise of information on the tiger man's origins

citation.text: "Johan", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: a conflict between the city-state of Bryce

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Shauku manipulated and imprisoned Johan to enslave him.
relations.quote: she had manipulated Johan to enslave him and use him to control Jamuraa

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: locked him into an Amber Prison .

relations.quote: a young human apprentice wizard working for Johan

pages_say.description: The Tirran emperor and sorcerer who builds an airship fleet to invade; protected by an Indestructible Aura, he is eaten by a sand wurm.

pages_say.description: A powerful, evil mage who tried to conquer western Jamuraa and was defeated.

pages_say.description: An evil wizard planning conquest, who killed Jaeger and is enslaved then freed from Shauku's prison.

pages_say.description: A powerful, evil red mage and shapeshifter, Tyrant of Tirras, who tried to conquer Jamuraa and died eaten by a sand wurm.

pages_say.description: The tyrant of Tirras who leads an invasion of Bryce and Palmyra and is the One of the prophecy.

pages_say.description: The Emperor-tyrant of Tirras who wages war on Bryce and Jamuraa and is devoured by a sand wurm.
